messages:
Nina (Product): Thanks for the clear roadmap segment today. A few customers asked for a concise follow-up on batching vs cache tradeoffs and what to expect in the next 8 weeks. Can runtime + SRE drop the quick plan here?

Ravi (Runtime): Short summary: focus areas = 1) kernel prioritization (low-latency vs throughput variants), 2) KV cache policies (per-customer + defaults), 3) adaptive batching. Timeline: perf experiments this sprint, beta toggles next sprint, canary rollout in 6 weeks.

Connor (SRE): For canaries, do we have an automated test harness that simulates chat workloads with long seqs? Want to run nightly.

Ravi (Runtime): Yep 1: chat-sim harness exists in infra/tests/perf. We[0m currently have a config that mimics 60/40 chat/complete. Connor, I will push a variant focused on long seq spikes (seq=1024) tonight.

Sam (Backend): Regarding KV policy: will eviction be LRU or time-based? We have sessions that prefer TTLs.

Ravi (Runtime): Plan: default LRU with configurable TTL overrides per-tenant. Hosted will expose an API flag; Dedicated/Private will have tenant-level policy setting.

Nina (Product): Any UX hooks needed from Product to expose these settings safely?

Ravi (Runtime): Minimal: a toggle for "aggressive eviction" and a per-tenant TTL input. Docs will advise opt-in only after checking session health.

Ava (VP Eng): If a customer flips aggressive eviction and we start seeing session failures, what's rollback look like?

Connor (SRE): Rollback playbook: 1) detect via session-failure signal, 2) flip tenant flag to conservative, 3) if still bad, route traffic to warmed dedicated pool. I'll write the runbook.

Ravi (Runtime): Also adding a runtime safety net: if session churn > X% in 5m, auto-disable aggressive eviction.

docs-bot: New doc published: internal/runtime/kernel-priority.md (link)

Nina (Product): Nice. Can we get sample SLO->routing rule for Console? e.g., p95 latency threshold -> fallback to throughput kernel.

Ravi (Runtime): Sample rule we plan to support:

```
rule {
  metric: "p95_latency_ms"
  threshold: 120
  duration: "5m"
  action: "route_to:kernel-throughput, precision:fp16"
}
```

Ravi (Runtime): Console team can implement UI that generates this JSON and wires to control-api. ETA for control-api endpoints: 2 sprints.

Sam (Backend): For Hosted beta flags, who owns rollout gating? We should be able to enable per-customer with feature flags.

Ravi (Runtime): Backend will own the flag gating, runtime will honor feature flag header. Sam to coordinate.

Connor (SRE): Action items from this thread: 1) Ravi to post perf artifacts + canary config (ETA: tonight) 2) Connor to add canary job + runbook (ETA: tomorrow AM) 3) Sam to wire feature-flag gate for Hosted (ETA: 2 sprints) 4) Nina/Product to draft Console UX for SLO rules (ETA: next week).

Ava (VP Eng): Please call out any blockers. If an infra quota or priority is needed, escalate here and Ill action.

Ravi (Runtime): Potential blocker: GPU slot shortage for canary runs if we do multiple seq=1024 experiments. If that happens, we may need to borrow Dedicated test capacity.

Connor (SRE): Noted. I'll check capacity and flag if we hit limits.

Nina (Product): Thanks all. Ill summarize and send the follow-up with links. Keep replies brief here; deep technical threads in eng-runtime. :rocket:
